pendentes.titulo: Avell Storm 480: o que entrega um notebook com i9 e RTX 4080
pendentes.alt: Notebook gamer preto e robusto, fechado, sobre uma mesa escura com luz vermelha suave ao fundo
pendentes.pedido: A large, thick black plastic gaming laptop, lid closed, resting on a dark matte desk, seen from a low three-quarter angle. Angular vents on its back edge catch a faint red rim light. A coiled power cable and a bulky power brick sit beside it. Dark, moody background with soft red ambient glow, shallow depth of field, cinematic product photography.
